Phase 5: database

05b. Data dictionary

In plain words
Every table and every column of the planned database, with what it means.
It is generated from schema.dbml, so it is always identical to the schema.
"Key" says if a column is the row's identity (PK), a link to another table (FK) or must be unique (UQ).
Money columns end in _minor (centimes). Rates end in _bp (basis points: 1,200 = 12%).
Read 05-database-schema.md first for the design and the reasons behind it.

Generated by python _tools/build_schema_docs.py. 77 tables, 808 columns, 35 enumerations, 156 foreign keys.

Accounts

user

Every person: guest, host, organisation member, staff. Constraints: unique lower(email), unique phone_e164, check (email is not null or phone_e164 is not null). Auth tables (emails, MFA authenticators, sessions) come from django-allauth and are not repeated here.

Column Type Required Key Default Meaning
id uuid yes PK Primary key (UUIDv7 made by the app, ordered by time).
email varchar(254) no Login email. Unique on lower(email) when not null.
email_verified_at timestamptz no Time of the event (UTC).
phone_e164 varchar(16) no E.164 phone, Algerian mobiles match ^+213[5-7][0-9]{8}$. Unique when not null.
phone_verified_at timestamptz no Required before the first booking (DEC-012).
password varchar(255) no Django password hash (argon2). Empty for phone-only accounts.

last_name_latin varchar(80) no
full_name_ar varchar(160) no Name in Arabic script, stored separately from the Latin form.
avatar_media_id uuid no FK media_asset Link to the media_asset row (many to one).
bio text no Short public introduction (max 500 characters).
spoken_languages varchar(2)[] no Languages the person speaks, ISO 639-1 codes, shown on host profiles.
home_commune_id int no FK commune Where the person lives (optional, private).
address_line varchar(255) no Private postal address (optional); never shown publicly.
preferred_locale varchar(2) yes fr en, fr or ar.
nationality_iso2 char(2) no Only when legally needed (foreign guest declaration, VERIFY).

Host Accounts And Organisations

host_account

The single thing that hosts: either one user (individual) or one organisation. Owns listings, trips, wallet and commission (resolves disagreement D-1). The active host account of a request comes from the session and is re-checked against membership on every call (workspace switcher, ORG-02). Check: (kind = individual and user_id not null and organization_id is null) or (kind = organization and organization_id not null and user_id is null).

Column Type Required Key Default Meaning
id uuid yes PK Primary key (UUIDv7 made by the app, ordered by time).
kind host_account_kind yes One of the host_account_kind values.
user_id uuid no FK user UQ Set when kind = individual.
organization_id uuid no FK organization UQ Set when kind = organization.
verification_status verification_status yes applied One of the verification_status values.
status_before_delete verification_status no One of the verification_status values.
default_approval_mode approval_mode yes request Default for new listings (BR-BKG-02).
commission_rate_override_bp int no Null = use host-type default from settings. 0 to 10000.
credit_limit_override_minor bigint no Null = settings default for the host type (BR-PAY-10).
host_cancellations_12m int yes 0 Cache recomputed by job.
rating_avg numeric(3,2) no Cache from published reviews (BR-REV-04).
review_count int yes 0
submitted_at timestamptz no Last submission for review; drives queue waiting time.
approved_at timestamptz no Time of the event (UTC).
created_at timestamptz yes When the row was created (UTC).
updated_at timestamptz yes When the row was last changed (UTC).
deleted_at timestamptz no Soft delete time; null = not deleted.

Catalogue: Listings And Room Types

listing

Checks: capacity_guests > 0; base_price_minor > 0; min_nights <= max_nights; discount bp between 0 and 9000; inventory_kind matches vertical (home/vehicle single, hotel/hostel room_pool, experience slot); (vertical = experience) = (experience_type is not null). Host offer rule (DEC-014, BR-HST-05): individual host accounts publish home and vehicle, agencies experience, hotels and hostels hotel/hostel; enforced by service and a trigger that reads host_account.kind and organization.business_category.

otp_send_log

Record of every one-time code sent (codes themselves stay in Redis, never stored). Feeds SMS budget alarms and pumping-fraud detection (ACC-02, BR-ACC-02). Kept 90 days.

status varchar(12) yes sent, failed, blocked_rate_limit.

Indexes: (phone_hash, created_at); (ip, created_at)
